item.title: 【SD Live Performances】C2C Festival Live Stream of Lorenzo Senni's "Vandalize Music"
item.description: In 2020, C2C Festival announce a festival during the covid era, calling it "CØC — The Festival As A Performance". A 4 day live stream started from November 5th to November 8th, hosted on C2C Official website. i have been searching this for months but was only been met with dead ends. Please comment here if you have the video of the whole live stream.
